verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs feature list states that alongside the OpenAI-compatible server it supports the Anthropic Messages API, so the capability is first-party and direct. However, that single line is the only evidence: there is no dedicated documentation of the endpoint path, supported parameters, streaming or tool-use behavior, or compatibility limits. missing for 10: dedicated Anthropic Messages endpoint documentation (path, request/response schema, supported features), independent or hands-on corroboration that Anthropic clients work against it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the server through an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint

citations.quote: OpenAI-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support
